_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ove uya taka Klondike Solitaire. Ombeto yawe ni ya kwamba ovike kadi zose ku mizungu ya msingi.

Milinganyo ya Mchezo:
- Mizungu ya msingi (F1-F4): Jenga juu kutoka Ace hadi Mfalme katika suti
- Mizungu ya meza (T1-T7): Jenga chini kwa kubadilisha rangi (nyekundu juu ya nyeusi, nyeusi juu ya nyekundu)
- Hisa: Chora kadi hadi mizungu ya taka
- Taka (W): Kadi ya juu inapatikana kwa mchezo

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Chora kadi kutoka hisa hadi taka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hamisha kadi kati ya mizungu
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. idadi inaweza pia kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhamisha kadi zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na ufunge alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya mizungu: W (taka), F1-F4 (msingi), T1-T7 (meza)

Unaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi katika zamu moja kwa kuvitenganisha na virambo:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Mfalme pekee anaweza kuwekwa kwenye mizungu ya meza tupu.
Vitendo vinavyotendwa kwa mpangilio - ikiwa kimoja kinafeli, vitendo vilivyobaki vitapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unaamini mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.
